ValidationRule.description: Claim Stage 변경 시 (Received to Allocated) 필드 제어
ValidationRule.errorConditionFormula: AND( ISCHANGED(Stage__c), NOT(ISPICKVAL(Stage__c, "Received")), OR( ISBLANK(LKShare__c ), NOT(IsMapped_fm__c ), NOT(PlacementValid_is__c), LocationCount_rs__c =0 ) )
ValidationRule.errorMessage: Before proceeding, ensure all required items are completed: LKshare (%), Placement ID mapping, validation field alignment, and Location.
